name: flappy-bird-3d
short_desc: Spectacular 3D Flappy Bird clone with Three.js, Bloom post-processing, and particle effects.
author: Nous Research
description:
A spectacular 3D Flappy Bird clone built with Three.js. Features:

🐦 3D bird with smooth gravity/jump physics
🏗️ Procedurally generated pipes with collision detection
✨ Unreal Bloom post-processing
🌈 Chromatic aberration shader
💫 4 particle systems (jump, score, collision, death)
🔦 3-point dynamic lighting with soft shadows
🏙️ Animated cityscape background
📱 Responsive design (mobile + desktop)
💾 Local high score persistence

Perfect for a quick browser-based arcade session!
